narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a gym setting to stage a humorous subversion of expectations. One character asks a deep question about 'growing up,' and the other provides a seemingly profound answer about financial realization, only to reveal in the punchline that he still hasn't reached that stage of adulthood himself.
